evidence: The playbook Localization table now mirrors the entrypoint: the boundary-walk row runs only when the chain can be re-run safely with every boundary reachable, logs only allowlisted redacted metadata (never raw bodies, headers, secrets, PII, or env/config values), and falls back to the telemetry walk, partial boundary evidence, or layer narrowing; the commit-bisection row narrows by pathspec only when evidence confines the cause to those paths and reruns the full range when no reproducing commit is found.
A drift guard was added above the table: a recipe there must never loosen a condition SKILL.md states, and SKILL.md wins on disagreement.
